data.narrative:
Baykar operates in Defense & Security as a private-stage company. The broader sector comprises 23 known peers, of which 2 trade publicly (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 operate privately, including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Saronic, and Quantum-Systems. However, the peer set lacks sufficient density at Baykar's specific stage and valuation tier to support robust median-based comparables.

Peer-Median valuation analysis is not applicable here. A search across same-stage, adjacent-stage, and similar-valuation-tier filters yielded zero datapoints meeting the minimum threshold of three comparable firms. The 23 same-sector peers are distributed across heterogeneous stages and scales, making sector-wide medians unreliable and potentially misleading. The identified private peer universe—Anduril, Helsing, Shield AI, Saronic, and Quantum-Systems—may offer directional context but lacks the homogeneity needed for formal multiples-based triangulation.

Without sufficient comparable data, this valuation cannot be supported by quantitative triangulation methods at this time. A credible range would require either: acquisition of financing data from the named private peers, access to non-public financing rounds, or expansion of the analysis window to include earlier or later-stage transactions in autonomous systems and defense technology. Current data constraints preclude a defensible point estimate or range.
